gloss: former site; ruins of a site

definitions.gloss: former site; site where something once stood
definitions.explanation: The land or location where a building, facility, or settlement once existed but has been demolished, abandoned, or repurposed. Often used in urban development and historical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跡地|あとち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A park was built on the former factory site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跡地|あとち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There is debate over how to use the former school site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跡地|あとち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: The castle ruins are now visited by many people as a tourist spot.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (trace, remains) + {地|ち} (land, ground). Commonly used in news and planning discussions about redevelopment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧{跡地|あとち} (former factory site)
- ⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧{跡地|あとち} (former military base site)
- {跡地|あとち}⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧ (reuse of a former site)
- {跡地|あとち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to build on a former site)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: ruins, archaeological site (older, historical significance)
- ⟦{廃墟|はいきょ}→廃墟：12453_haikyo⟧: ruins (emphasizes decay and abandonment)
- ⟦{更地|さらち}→更地：17562_sarachi⟧: vacant lot, cleared land (land with nothing on it)
